title: Mere Christianity
author: C. S. Lewis
summary: Based on C. S. Lewis's wartime BBC radio talks, this book sets out a reasoned defense of Christian belief. It moves from a shared sense of right and wrong to the nature of God, morality and Christian life.
readIf: you want a clear, logical case for Christianity from a well-known writer.
skipIf: you want a neutral overview of religion or are not receptive to apologetics.
